description: Returns the current status of a quote (id = quote_id) or a task (id = task_id): status, next_action (a short text on the next step), payments, updates, and messages with the operator (newest first, from operator or you). The answer is short: older_updates and older_messages count what is left out; full=true returns everything. With the optional message the call also stores a plain-text reply to the operator and e-mails it to the operator; message_sent is then true. While the operator has a message that has not been returned yet, the reply is not stored (message_sent: false) and the answer contains that message. The same text again within 10 minutes is ignored (duplicate_ignored: true). A status can change at any time; every call returns the state at that moment. test_mode true marks a test order: nothing is paid or invoiced.

access_token.description: Access token of the quote and its task, issued with the quote.

message.description: Optional reply to the operator: plain text, 1-2000 characters. Without it the call is a plain status check.

name: get_status
title: Get status or answer operator
